source_handle: *18 Local povidone iodine disinfection, 4% articaine infiltration anesthesia, after the anesthetic takes effect, separate the gums, loosen the teeth, and remove the tooth with extraction forceps. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding. *48 Under local anesthesia, electric knife trims the gums. *36 Remove all the decay, make sure there is no marrow leakage, prepare the cavity, blow dry the cavity, apply adhesive, fill with resin, light cure, adjust the high points of the filling body, and polish.
